text_sanskrit: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान् । कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु ॥ १३-२२ ॥
itrans: puruShaH prakR^itistho hi bhu~N.hkte prakR^itijAnguNAn . kAraNaM guNasa~Ngo.asya sadasadyonijanmasu .. 13-22 ..
translation: Purusha (Jiva) standing in Prakriti indeed experiences the qualities or the results proceeding from Prakriti; the attachment to the qualities (Satva, Rajas and Tamas) is the cause for his going through births in good and evil wombs.
